description: National Physical Planning Department - Declaring that the area of land compriing Galphilla Raja Maha Vihara as Sacred Area and an Urban Development Area and directing that an outline scheme be prepared for the whole of the area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of a specific area of land (2.6173 Hectares) as an "Urban Development Area" called the "Galpihilla Rajamaha Vihara Sacred Area" under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, lot numbers, and survey information, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
